title: Does Superdeterminism save Quantum Mechanics? Or does it kill free will and destroy science?
summary: Sabine Hossenfelder explains superdeterminism as an interpretation of quantum mechanics, addressing common objections and misconceptions, including the worry that it kills free will or science. She ties it to Bell's theorem and hidden variables.
why: HN commenters point to it as a clear explanation of Bell's theorem and superdeterminism, though some criticize it as knocking down strawmen.

quote.text: The video does the subject justice much better than I can
